verdict.rationale: Paddle's docs show Billing retries failed payments on automatically-collected subscriptions up to seven times over 30 days. Paddle Retain's Payment Recovery adds smart 'Tactical Retries', configurable failed-payment notification emails, in-app retry forms, and a configurable outcome for past-due subscriptions. Smart dunning and recovery emails depend on the separate Retain tier, which cannot be tested in sandbox. Missing for 10: smart dunning and emails without the Retain add-on, sandbox testability, detail on email customization and retry logic, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
